sql: SELECT "FromCurrencyCode" AS from_currency_code, "ToCurrencyCode" AS to_currency_code, AVG("AverageRate") AS avg_rate FROM "Sales"."CurrencyRate" WHERE "CurrencyRateDate" >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND "CurrencyRateDate" < DATE '2014-01-01' GROUP BY "FromCurrencyCode", "ToCurrencyCode" ORDER BY from_currency_code, to_currency_code

SELECT sr."ReasonType" AS reason_type, COUNT(DISTINCT rel."SalesOrderID") AS order_count FROM "Sales"."SalesReason" AS sr JOIN "Sales"."SalesOrderHeaderSalesReason" AS rel ON rel."SalesReasonID" = sr."SalesReasonID" GROUP BY sr."ReasonType" ORDER BY reason_type

SELECT "BusinessEntityID" AS business_entity_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "ProductID") AS product_count, AVG("StandardPrice") AS avg_standard_price FROM "Purchasing"."ProductVendor" GROUP BY "BusinessEntityID" ORDER BY business_entity_id
SELECT "Status" AS status, COUNT(*) AS purchase_order_count, SUM("SubTotal" + "TaxAmt" + "Freight") AS total_due FROM "Purchasing"."PurchaseOrderHeader" GROUP BY "Status" ORDER BY status

SELECT h."Status" AS status, SUM(d."RejectedQty")::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(d."OrderQty"), 0) AS rejected_ratio FROM "Purchasing"."PurchaseOrderHeader" AS h JOIN "Purchasing"."PurchaseOrderDetail" AS d ON d."PurchaseOrderID" = h."PurchaseOrderID" GROUP BY h."Status" ORDER BY status

SELECT "BillOfMaterialsID" AS bill_of_materials_id, "ProductAssemblyID" AS product_assembly_id, "ComponentID" AS component_id, "StartDate" AS start_date, "EndDate" AS end_date FROM "Production"."BillOfMaterials" WHERE "StartDate" <= DATE '2013-01-01' AND ("EndDate" > DATE '2013-01-01' OR "EndDate" IS NULL) ORDER BY bill_of_materials_id

SELECT sp."StateProvinceID" AS state_province_id, sp."Name" AS name, AVG(str."TaxRate") AS avg_tax_rate FROM "Person"."StateProvince" AS sp JOIN "Sales"."SalesTaxRate" AS str ON str."StateProvinceID" = sp."StateProvinceID" GROUP BY sp."StateProvinceID", sp."Name" ORDER BY state_province_id

SELECT d."DepartmentID" AS department_id, d."Name" AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT edh."BusinessEntityID") AS employee_count FROM "HumanResources"."Department" AS d JOIN "HumanResources"."EmployeeDepartmentHistory" AS edh ON edh."DepartmentID" = d."DepartmentID" WHERE edh."StartDate" >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND edh."StartDate" < DATE '2014-01-01' GROUP BY d."DepartmentID", d."Name" ORDER BY department_id

SELECT sr."ReasonType" AS reason_type, COUNT(DISTINCT rel."SalesOrderID") AS order_count FROM "Sales"."SalesReason" AS sr JOIN "Sales"."SalesOrderHeaderSalesReason" AS rel ON rel."SalesReasonID" = sr."SalesReasonID" JOIN "Sales"."SalesOrderHeader" AS sh ON sh."SalesOrderID" = rel."SalesOrderID" WHERE sh."OrderDate" >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND sh."OrderDate" < DATE '2014-01-01' GROUP BY sr."ReasonType" ORDER BY order_count DESC, reason_type

SELECT p."Name" AS product_name, SUM(i."Quantity") AS inventory_quantity FROM "Production"."ProductInventory" AS i JOIN "Production"."Product" AS p ON p."ProductID" = i."ProductID" GROUP BY p."ProductID", p."Name" ORDER BY inventory_quantity DESC, product_name ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT st."TerritoryID" AS territory_id, st."Name" AS territory_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(sh."SubTotal") AS subtotal FROM "Sales"."SalesOrderHeader" AS sh JOIN "Sales"."SalesTerritory" AS st ON st."TerritoryID" = sh."TerritoryID" WHERE sh."OrderDate" >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND sh."OrderDate" < DATE '2014-01-01' GROUP BY st."TerritoryID", st."Name" ORDER BY territory_id

SELECT sm."Name" AS ship_method, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(sh."Freight") AS total_freight FROM "Sales"."SalesOrderHeader" AS sh JOIN "Purchasing"."ShipMethod" AS sm ON sm."ShipMethodID" = sh."ShipMethodID" WHERE sh."OrderDate" >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND sh."OrderDate" < DATE '2014-01-01' GROUP BY sm."ShipMethodID", sm."Name" ORDER BY sm."ShipMethodID"

SELECT pc."Name" AS category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT p."ProductID") AS product_count FROM "Production"."ProductCategory" AS pc LEFT JOIN "Production"."ProductSubcategory" AS ps ON ps."ProductCategoryID" = pc."ProductCategoryID" LEFT JOIN "Production"."Product" AS p ON p."ProductSubcategoryID" = ps."ProductSubcategoryID" GROUP BY pc."ProductCategoryID", pc."Name" ORDER BY pc."ProductCategoryID"

SELECT l."LocationID" AS location_id, l."Name" AS location_name, COALESCE(SUM(i."Quantity"), 0) AS inventory_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT i."ProductID") AS product_count FROM "Production"."Location" AS l LEFT JOIN "Production"."ProductInventory" AS i ON i."LocationID" = l."LocationID" GROUP BY l."LocationID", l."Name" ORDER BY location_id

SELECT cr."Name" AS country_region_name, COUNT(sp."StateProvinceID") AS state_province_count FROM "Person"."CountryRegion" AS cr LEFT JOIN "Person"."StateProvince" AS sp ON sp."CountryRegionCode" = cr."CountryRegionCode" GROUP BY cr."CountryRegionCode", cr."Name" ORDER BY country_region_name

SELECT v."BusinessEntityID" AS vendor_id, v."Name" AS vendor_name, poh."Status" AS status, COUNT(*) AS purchase_order_count, SUM(poh."SubTotal") AS subtotal FROM "Purchasing"."Vendor" AS v JOIN "Purchasing"."PurchaseOrderHeader" AS poh ON poh."VendorID" = v."BusinessEntityID" GROUP BY v."BusinessEntityID", v."Name", poh."Status" ORDER BY vendor_id, status

SELECT d."DepartmentID" AS department_id, d."Name" AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT edh."BusinessEntityID") AS employee_count FROM "HumanResources"."Department" AS d LEFT JOIN "HumanResources"."EmployeeDepartmentHistory" AS edh ON edh."DepartmentID" = d."DepartmentID" AND edh."StartDate" <= DATE '2013-06-30' AND (edh."EndDate" > DATE '2013-06-30' OR edh."EndDate" IS NULL) GROUP BY d."DepartmentID", d."Name" ORDER BY department_id

SELECT pc."Name" AS category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i."ProductID") AS product_count, SUM(i."Quantity") AS inventory_quantity FROM "Production"."ProductInventory" AS i JOIN "Production"."Product" AS p ON p."ProductID" = i."ProductID" JOIN "Production"."ProductSubcategory" AS ps ON ps."ProductSubcategoryID" = p."ProductSubcategoryID" JOIN "Production"."ProductCategory" AS pc ON pc."ProductCategoryID" = ps."ProductCategoryID" GROUP BY pc."ProductCategoryID", pc."Name" ORDER BY pc."ProductCategoryID"

SELECT pc."Name" AS category_name, ps."Name" AS subcategory_name, COUNT(p."ProductID") AS product_count, AVG(p."StandardCost") AS avg_standard_cost, AVG(p."ListPrice") AS avg_list_price FROM "Production"."Product" AS p JOIN "Production"."ProductSubcategory" AS ps ON ps."ProductSubcategoryID" = p."ProductSubcategoryID" JOIN "Production"."ProductCategory" AS pc ON pc."ProductCategoryID" = ps."ProductCategoryID" GROUP BY pc."ProductCategoryID", pc."Name", ps."ProductSubcategoryID", ps."Name" ORDER BY pc."ProductCategoryID", ps."ProductSubcategoryID"

SELECT v."BusinessEntityID" AS vendor_id, v."Name" AS vendor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pv."ProductID") AS product_count, AVG(pv."StandardPrice") AS avg_standard_price, AVG(pv."AverageLeadTime") AS avg_lead_time_days FROM "Purchasing"."Vendor" AS v JOIN "Purchasing"."ProductVendor" AS pv ON pv."BusinessEntityID" = v."BusinessEntityID" GROUP BY v."BusinessEntityID", v."Name" ORDER BY vendor_id
